_metadata.description: Reusable adapter definitions, retrieval capabilities, configuration requirements, and implementation status.

pilot_eligibility_rule.note: Eligibility is a validation rule, not proof that an adapter is implemented, permitted, or production-ready.

greenhouse.notes: Public job-board endpoint. Confirm response completeness and pagination behavior against representative boards before relying on the capability.

workday.notes: Uses a POST request for job-list retrieval. Job descriptions may require a secondary detail request. host_prefix includes the Workday host/version prefix, for example oldmutual.wd3.

lever.notes: Validate pagination, board coverage, and public access behavior before implementation.

breezy_hr.notes: Initial ATS investigation priority from the project source of truth. Do not implement until a supported public retrieval method and employer evidence are established.

ashby.notes: Do not implement until the public endpoint, response shape, and employer relationship are verified.

placement_partner.notes: Separate recruitment/staffing pipeline. Do not count these sources toward verified direct-employer adapter coverage. Validate access behavior and source restrictions before use.
